register.question: How do I register?
register.after: , choose a profile type (viewer, regular or business) and fill in the form: first name, last name, email and password (at least 6 characters). After registering, you are signed in right away.

login.question: How do I log in?
login.answer: Tap "Log in" and enter the email and password you registered with. If there have been too many failed attempts, sign-in is temporarily limited — wait a while and try again.

password.question: What should I do if I forgot my password?
password.answer: There is no self-service password reset on the site. Write to the administration on Telegram or to the support email — we will help you regain access to your account after verifying your identity.

editProfile.question: How do I edit my profile?
editProfile.answer: Log in, open the user menu and choose "Edit profile". There you can change your name, contacts, description, photo and other profile fields.

report.question: How do I report a user or content?
report.answer: Use the "Report" button on a profile, service, request or in a chat, choose a reason and, if you wish, describe the problem. You can also send a link to the profile or content with a short description on Telegram or to the support email.

delete.before: Log in and use the form on the
delete.after: page (password confirmation required). If you cannot log in, send a request to support following the instructions on that page.

free.question: Is the platform free?
free.answer: Yes. Using the platform and listing services is free of charge.

deletionNote: We aim to complete an account deletion request within 30 days of verifying the account owner's identity.
